resources.string: Vaani needs the microphone to turn your speech into text — entirely on this phone, nothing is sent anywhere.
Vaani isn\'t turned on as a keyboard yet. Tap below to open Android\'s keyboard list, then switch Vaani on.
Vaani is turned on. Now tap below to pick it as the keyboard you\'re typing with right now.
Vaani is set up and ready. Open any app — WhatsApp, Gmail, Notes — and start speaking or typing.
